outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heatmap overlays on tissue images depicting cell-type distribution, not a quantitative summary plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a box plot (exempt category, as it already shows the distribution), and individual data points (dots for each spatial spot) are additionally overlaid on top of the boxes.
Panel C shows GSEA enrichment score line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays since these would make the plot unreadable.

Panel D is a bar chart of log2 fold change values per gene derived from differential expression analysis across the full spatial dataset; each bar represents a single computed statistic (with associated p-value) rather than a mean of discrete biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
